HOME SCIENCE MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting.

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meals for Special Occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meals for Special Occasions.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meals for Special Occasions.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Meals for Special Occasions.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meals for Special Occasions.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pastry Making? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Pastry Making.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Pastry Making.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pastry Making.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pastry Making.

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Yeast Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Yeast Products.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Yeast Products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Yeast Products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Yeast Products.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Special Treatment in Laundry Work? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Special Treatment in Laundry Work.

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Careers in Home Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Clothing Construction Processes: Facings 3.2 Clothing Construction Processes: Co and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
